action.details: Replaces the editable selection with the clipboard's plain text, then places the original selected text on the clipboard. The swap is guarded so a newer user Copy or Cut is never overwritten while the source app is completing the paste.
action.exampleOutput: Selection becomes the previous clipboard text; clipboard becomes Draft A.
action.name: Swap with Clipboard
action.privacySummary: ActionClip exchanges the selected text and macOS clipboard text locally. Neither value leaves your Mac.
action.requirements: The source selection must be editable and the clipboard must contain plain text.
action.summary: Swap selected text with the clipboard text.
